## ANN-MB2_DataSheet_UBXDOC-GPS-27500.pdf

- Title: ANN-MB2 Data sheet. L1/L2/L5/E6/B3/L all-band high precision GNSS antenna.
- Document number: UBXDOC-GPS-27500
- Author and copyright holder: u-blox AG (www.u-blox.com)
- PDF dated 2025-02-27, 16 pages. Included unmodified.

It is the source for every antenna dimension used in this project (see `docs/DESIGN.md`).
u-blox and ANN-MB2 are names of u-blox AG. This project is not affiliated with or
endorsed by u-blox.
